versos.hebraico: וְֽאוּלָ֗ם שְׁמַֽע־נָ֣א אִיּ֣וֹב מִלָּ֑י וְֽכָל־דְּבָרַ֥י הַאֲזִֽינָה׃

controles.web: “However, Job, please hear my speech, and listen to all my words.
controles.kjv: Wherefore, Job, I pray thee, hear my speeches, and hearken to all my words.
controles.livre: Portanto, Jó, ouve, por favor, meus dizeres, e dá ouvidos a todas as minhas palavras.

versos.hebraico: הִנֵּה־נָ֭א פָּתַ֣חְתִּי פִ֑י דִּבְּרָ֖ה לְשׁוֹנִ֣י בְחִכִּֽי׃

controles.web: See now, I have opened my mouth. My tongue has spoken in my mouth.
controles.kjv: Behold, now I have opened my mouth, my tongue hath spoken in my mouth.
controles.livre: Eis que já abri minha boca; minha língua já fala debaixo do meu céu da boca.

versos.hebraico: יֹֽשֶׁר־לִבִּ֥י אֲמָרָ֑י וְדַ֥עַת שְׂ֝פָתַ֗י בָּר֥וּר מִלֵּֽלוּ׃

controles.web: My words shall utter the uprightness of my heart. That which my lips know they shall speak sincerely.
controles.kjv: My words shall be of the uprightness of my heart: and my lips shall utter knowledge clearly.
controles.livre: Meus dizeres pronunciarão a integridade do meu coração, e o puro conhecimento dos meus lábios.

versos.hebraico: רֽוּחַ־אֵ֥ל עָשָׂ֑תְנִי וְנִשְׁמַ֖ת שַׁדַּ֣י תְּחַיֵּֽנִי׃

controles.web: The Spirit of God has made me, and the breath of the Almighty gives me life.
controles.kjv: The Spirit of God hath made me, and the breath of the Almighty hath given me life.
controles.livre: O Espírito de Deus me fez, e o sopro do Todo-Poderoso me deu vida.

versos.hebraico: אִם־תּוּכַ֥ל הֲשִׁיבֵ֑נִי עֶרְכָ֥ה לְ֝פָנַ֗י הִתְיַצָּֽבָה׃

controles.web: If you can, answer me. Set your words in order before me, and stand up.
controles.kjv: If thou canst answer me, set thy words in order before me, stand up.
controles.livre: Se puderes, responde-me; dispõe-te perante mim, e persiste.

versos.hebraico: הֵן־אֲנִ֣י כְפִ֣יךָ לָאֵ֑ל מֵ֝חֹ֗מֶר קֹרַ֥צְתִּי גַם־אָֽנִי׃

controles.web: Behold, I am toward God even as you are. I am also formed out of the clay.
controles.kjv: Behold, I am according to thy wish in God’s stead: I also am formed out of the clay.
controles.livre: Eis que para Deus eu sou como tu; do barro também eu fui formado.

versos.hebraico: הִנֵּ֣ה אֵ֭מָתִי לֹ֣א תְבַעֲתֶ֑ךָּ וְ֝אַכְפִּ֗י עָלֶ֥יךָ לֹא־יִכְבָּֽד׃

controles.web: Behold, my terror shall not make you afraid, neither shall my pressure be heavy on you.
controles.kjv: Behold, my terror shall not make thee afraid, neither shall my hand be heavy upon thee.
controles.livre: Eis que meu terror não te espantará, nem minha mão será pesada sobre ti.

versos.hebraico: אַ֭ךְ אָמַ֣רְתָּ בְאָזְנָ֑י וְק֖וֹל מִלִּ֣ין אֶשְׁמָֽע׃

controles.web: “Surely you have spoken in my hearing, I have heard the voice of your words, saying,
controles.kjv: Surely thou hast spoken in mine hearing, and I have heard the voice of thy words, saying,
controles.livre: Certamente tu disseste a meus ouvidos, e eu ouvi a voz de tuas palavras,

versos.hebraico: זַ֥ךְ אֲנִ֗י בְּֽלִ֫י פָ֥שַׁע חַ֥ף אָנֹכִ֑י וְלֹ֖א עָוֺ֣ן לִֽי׃

controles.web: ‘I am clean, without disobedience. I am innocent, neither is there iniquity in me.
controles.kjv: I am clean without transgression, I am innocent; neither is there iniquity in me.
controles.livre: Que diziam : Eu sou limpo e sem transgressão; sou inocente, e não tenho culpa.

versos.hebraico: הֵ֣ן תְּ֭נוּאוֹת עָלַ֣י יִמְצָ֑א יַחְשְׁבֵ֖נִי לְאוֹיֵ֣ב לֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Behold, he finds occasions against me. He counts me for his enemy.
controles.kjv: Behold, he findeth occasions against me, he counteth me for his enemy,
controles.livre: Eis que Deus buscou pretextos contra mim, e me tem por seu inimigo.

versos.hebraico: יָשֵׂ֣ם בַּסַּ֣ד רַגְלָ֑י יִ֝שְׁמֹ֗ר כָּל־אָרְחֹתָֽי׃

controles.web: He puts my feet in the stocks. He marks all my paths.’
controles.kjv: He putteth my feet in the stocks, he marketh all my paths.
controles.livre: Ele pôs meus pés no tronco, e observa todas as minhas veredas.

versos.hebraico: הֶן־זֹ֣את לֹא־צָדַ֣קְתָּ אֶעֱנֶ֑ךָּ כִּֽי־יִרְבֶּ֥ה אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַ מֵאֱנֽוֹשׁ׃

controles.web: “Behold, I will answer you. In this you are not just, for God is greater than man.
controles.kjv: Behold, in this thou art not just: I will answer thee, that God is greater than man.
controles.livre: Eis que nisto não foste justo, eu te respondo; pois Deus é maior que o ser humano.

versos.hebraico: מַ֭דּוּעַ אֵלָ֣יו רִיב֑וֹתָ כִּ֥י כָל־דְּ֝בָרָ֗יו לֹ֣א־יַעֲנֶֽה׃

controles.web: Why do you strive against him, because he doesn’t give account of any of his matters?
controles.kjv: Why dost thou strive against him? for he giveth not account of any of his matters.
controles.livre: Por que razão brigas contra ele por não dar resposta às palavras do ser humano?

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־בְאַחַ֥ת יְדַבֶּר־אֵ֑ל וּ֝בִשְׁתַּ֗יִם לֹ֣א יְשׁוּרֶֽנָּה׃

controles.web: For God speaks once, yes twice, though man pays no attention.
controles.kjv: For God speaketh once, yea twice, yet man perceiveth it not.
controles.livre: Contudo Deus fala uma ou duas vezes, ainda que o ser humano não entenda.

versos.hebraico: בַּחֲל֤וֹם׀ חֶזְי֬וֹן לַ֗יְלָה בִּנְפֹ֣ל תַּ֭רְדֵּמָה עַל־אֲנָשִׁ֑ים בִּ֝תְנוּמ֗וֹת עֲלֵ֣י מִשְׁכָּֽב׃

controles.web: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falls on men, in slumbering on the bed;
controles.kjv: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falleth upon men, in slumberings upon the bed;
controles.livre: Em sonho ou em visão noturna, quando o sono profundo cai sobre as pessoas, e adormecem na cama.

versos.hebraico: אָ֣ז יִ֭גְלֶה אֹ֣זֶן אֲנָשִׁ֑ים וּבְמֹ֖סָרָ֣ם יַחְתֹּֽם׃

controles.web: Then he opens the ears of men, and seals their instruction,
controles.kjv: Then he openeth the ears of men, and sealeth their instruction,
controles.livre: Então o revela ao ouvido das pessoas, e os sela com advertências;

versos.hebraico: לְ֭הָסִיר אָדָ֣ם מַעֲשֶׂ֑ה וְגֵוָ֖ה מִגֶּ֣בֶר יְכַסֶּֽה׃

controles.web: That he may withdraw man from his purpose, and hide pride from man.
controles.kjv: That he may withdraw man from his purpose, and hide pride from man.
controles.livre: Para desviar ao ser humano de sua obra, e do homem a soberba.

versos.hebraico: יַחְשֹׂ֣ךְ נַ֭פְשׁוֹ מִנִּי־שָׁ֑חַת וְ֝חַיָּת֗וֹ מֵעֲבֹ֥ר בַּשָּֽׁלַח׃

controles.web: He keeps back his soul from the pit, and his life from perishing by the sword.
controles.kjv: He keepeth back his soul from the pit, and his life from perishing by the sword.
controles.livre: Para desviar a sua alma da perdição, e sua vida de passar pela espada.

versos.hebraico: וְהוּכַ֣ח בְּ֭מַכְאוֹב עַל־מִשְׁכָּב֑וֹ וריב עֲצָמָ֣יו אֵתָֽן׃

controles.web: He is chastened also with pain on his bed, with continual strife in his bones;
controles.kjv: He is chastened also with pain upon his bed, and the multitude of his bones with strong pain:
controles.livre: Também em sua cama é castigado com dores, com luta constante em seus ossos,

versos.hebraico: וְזִֽהֲמַ֣תּוּ חַיָּת֣וֹ לָ֑חֶם וְ֝נַפְשׁ֗וֹ מַאֲכַ֥ל תַּאֲוָֽה׃

controles.web: So that his life abhors bread, and his soul dainty food.
controles.kjv: So that his life abhorreth bread, and his soul dainty meat.
controles.livre: De modo que sua vida detesta até o pão, e sua alma a comida deliciosa.

versos.hebraico: יִ֣כֶל בְּשָׂר֣וֹ מֵרֹ֑אִי ושפי עַ֝צְמוֹתָ֗יו לֹ֣א רֻאּֽוּ׃

controles.web: His flesh is so consumed away, that it can’t be seen. His bones that were not seen stick out.
controles.kjv: His flesh is consumed away, that it cannot be seen; and his bones that were not seen stick out.
controles.livre: Sua carne desaparece da vista, e seus ossos, que antes não se viam, aparecem.

versos.hebraico: וַתִּקְרַ֣ב לַשַּׁ֣חַת נַפְשׁ֑וֹ וְ֝חַיָּת֗וֹ לַֽמְמִתִֽים׃

controles.web: Yes, his soul draws near to the pit, and his life to the destroyers.
controles.kjv: Yea, his soul draweth near unto the grave, and his life to the destroyers.
controles.livre: Sua alma se aproxima da cova, e sua vida dos que causam a morte.

versos.hebraico: אִם־יֵ֤שׁ עָלָ֨יו׀ מַלְאָ֗ךְ מֵלִ֗יץ אֶחָ֥ד מִנִּי־אָ֑לֶף לְהַגִּ֖יד לְאָדָ֣ם יָשְׁרֽוֹ׃

controles.web: “If there is beside him an angel, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to show to man what is right for him;
controles.kjv: If there be a messenger with him, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to shew unto man his uprightness:
controles.livre: Se com ele, pois, houver algum anjo, algum intérprete; um dentre mil, para anunciar ao ser humano o que lhe é correto,

versos.hebraico: וַיְחֻנֶּ֗נּוּ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר פְּ֭דָעֵהוּ מֵרֶ֥דֶת שָׁ֗חַת מָצָ֥אתִי כֹֽפֶר׃

controles.web: then God is gracious to him, and says, ‘Deliver him from going down to the pit, I have found a ransom.’
controles.kjv: Then he is gracious unto him, and saith, Deliver him from going down to the pit: I have found a ransom.
controles.livre: Então Deus terá misericórdia dele, e lhe dirá: Livra-o, para que não desça à perdição; já achei o resgate.

versos.hebraico: רֻֽטֲפַ֣שׁ בְּשָׂר֣וֹ מִנֹּ֑עַר יָ֝שׁ֗וּב לִימֵ֥י עֲלוּמָֽיו׃

controles.web: His flesh shall be fresher than a child’s. He returns to the days of his youth.
controles.kjv: His flesh shall be fresher than a child’s: he shall return to the days of his youth:
controles.livre: Sua carne se rejuvenescerá mais do que era na infância, e voltará aos dias de sua juventude.

versos.hebraico: יֶעְתַּ֤ר אֶל־אֱל֨וֹהַּ׀ וַיִּרְצֵ֗הוּ וַיַּ֣רְא פָּ֭נָיו בִּתְרוּעָ֑ה וַיָּ֥שֶׁב לֶ֝אֱנ֗וֹשׁ צִדְקָתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: He prays to God, and he is favorable to him, so that he sees his face with joy. He restores to man his righteousness.
controles.kjv: He shall pray unto God, and he will be favourable unto him: and he shall see his face with joy: for he will render unto man his righteousness.
controles.livre: Ele orará a Deus, que se agradará dele; e verá sua face com júbilo, porque ele restituirá ao ser humano sua justiça.

versos.hebraico: יָשֹׁ֤ר׀ עַל־אֲנָשִׁ֗ים וַיֹּ֗אמֶר חָ֭טָאתִי וְיָשָׁ֥ר הֶעֱוֵ֗יתִי וְלֹא־שָׁ֥וָה לִֽי׃

controles.web: He sings before men, and says, ‘I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, and it didn’t profit me.
controles.kjv: He looketh upon men, and if any say, I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, and it profited me not;
controles.livre: Ele olhará para as pessoas, e dirá: Pequei, e perverti o que era correto, o que de nada me aproveitou.

versos.hebraico: פָּדָ֣ה נפשי מֵעֲבֹ֣ר בַּשָּׁ֑חַת וחיתי בָּא֥וֹר תִּרְאֶֽה׃

controles.web: He has redeemed my soul from going into the pit. My life shall see the light.’
controles.kjv: He will deliver his soul from going into the pit, and his life shall see the light.
controles.livre: Porém Deus livrou minha alma para que eu não passasse à cova, e agora minha vida vê a luz!

versos.hebraico: הֶן־כָּל־אֵ֭לֶּה יִפְעַל־אֵ֑ל פַּעֲמַ֖יִם שָׁל֣וֹשׁ עִם־גָּֽבֶר׃

controles.web: “Behold, God works all these things, twice, yes three times, with a man,
controles.kjv: Lo, all these things worketh God oftentimes with man,
controles.livre: Eis que Deus faz tudo isto duas ou três vezes com o ser humano,

versos.hebraico: לְהָשִׁ֣יב נַ֭פְשׁוֹ מִנִּי־שָׁ֑חַת לֵ֝א֗וֹר בְּא֣וֹר הַֽחַיִּים׃

controles.web: to bring back his soul from the pit, that he may be enlightened with the light of the living.
controles.kjv: To bring back his soul from the pit, to be enlightened with the light of the living.
controles.livre: Para desviar sua alma da perdição, e o iluminar com a luz dos viventes.

versos.hebraico: הַקְשֵׁ֖ב אִיּ֥וֹב שְֽׁמַֽע־לִ֑י הַ֝חֲרֵ֗שׁ וְאָנֹכִ֥י אֲדַבֵּֽר׃

controles.web: Mark well, Job, and listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will speak.
controles.kjv: Mark well, O Job, hearken unto me: hold thy peace, and I will speak.
controles.livre: Presta atenção, Jó, e ouve-me; cala-te, e eu falarei.

versos.hebraico: אִם־יֵשׁ־מִלִּ֥ין הֲשִׁיבֵ֑נִי דַּ֝בֵּ֗ר כִּֽי־חָפַ֥צְתִּי צַדְּקֶֽךָּ׃

controles.web: If you have anything to say, answer me. Speak, for I desire to justify you.
controles.kjv: If thou hast any thing to say, answer me: speak, for I desire to justify thee.
controles.livre: Se tiveres o que dizer, responde-me; fala, porque eu quero te justificar.

versos.hebraico: אִם־אַ֭יִן אַתָּ֥ה שְֽׁמַֽע־לִ֑י הַ֝חֲרֵ֗שׁ וַאֲאַלֶּפְךָ֥ חָכְמָֽה׃ס

controles.web: If not, listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will teach you wisdom.”
controles.kjv: If not, hearken unto me: hold thy peace, and I shall teach thee wisdom.
controles.livre: E se não, escuta-me; cala-te, e eu ensinarei sabedoria.
